body.statement: Unless \(\mathrm{RP}=\mathrm{NP}\), there is no fully polynomial randomized approximation scheme for the number of independent sets in finite simple graphs of maximum degree at most six.

source.verbatim_statement: Theorem 2. Unless \(\mathrm{NP}=\mathrm{RP}\) for every \(d\geq6\) there does not exist a fully polynomial approximation scheme for counting independent sets.

attestation.note: Transcribed from the opening clause of Theorem 2; the remainder of that theorem specifies graphs of maximum degree at most \(d\).
